name: github.com/openshift-online/rh-trex-ai/components/api-server
reason: HyperShell requires RegisterPrefixedRoutes to mount ADLC extension kinds under /api/hypershell/ext (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#62), plus gRPC transport security fix (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#54), JWT issuer and audience validation (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#52), and fail-closed signed-token verification (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#53). The framework moved its Go module to components/api-server (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#45) and publishes no tag for that module path, so a pseudo-version is required.
compensatingVerification: The dependency is commit-pinned; API server formatting, vet, golangci-lint, unit tests, and integration tests run against that exact commit.

name: github.com/rh-amarin/rh-trex-ai/components/api-server
reason: Temporary replacement for github.com/openshift-online/rh-trex-ai/components/api-server in components/cli. HyperShell adopts the generated CLI and terminal UI from openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#58 (config store and token provider hooks, proxy-aware default HTTP client, generated delete and update commands, the TUI runtime and TokenProvider), which is unmerged, so the commit exists only on the PR branch of a fork and no tag exists. Remove this entry and the replace directive when #58 merges and the pin moves to the merged upstream commit.
compensatingVerification: The dependency is commit-pinned by full SHA in scripts/rh-trex-ai.ref and components/cli/go.mod. make check regenerates the CLI and the TUI descriptor from that same commit and fails on any difference, and the hsctl unit tests run against that exact commit.
